policy.operation: Static Git blobs and retained WIP files only; derived output written only under coverage directory
policy.historicalScope: Every selected historical productRef full 5f-to-product changed set; excludes docs/, iteration-control/, AGENTS.md; includes tests/fixtures/build/config if changed
policy.byteCovered: True only if EVERY historical changed path has identical bytes/absence at target; SHA256, byte count and existence match. Not a semantic coverage or review Pass claim.

classification.same: historical and target byte identity/absence equal
classification.different: target available, differs from historical and from base
classification.missing: historical file absent in target, or path outside explicit WIP packet
classification.no-longer-delta: target is present and byte-identical to base, while historical differs

policy.scopeCaveat: Committed targets compare entire tree for historical paths; WIP targets are strictly their explicit54/149 packet. targetInChangedOrExplicitPacket and targetDiffersFromBase preserve this distinction.
policy.reviewPass: No test/internal/design Pass is transferred; no specified task is created by this output
policy.authorization: Historical author fields copied from backlog are evidence only; no new write grant
policy.runtime: No repository Python/JS imports or execution, product/test/DB/native/child/GUI launched
